baseline_findings.finding: nemo-transfer-manifest.json is stale at HEAD: committed additions (effect-runtime kernel, ffi plugin_host_location, tcb invariants) and tracked file content drift are undeclared; untracked local artifacts (.pytest_cache, .ruff_cache, egg-info, _native.abi3.so, jsonl) pollute the on-disk digest because the exclusion set names directories only

every GitHub handler (issue create/comment/close/update, pr create/merge, direct reads) constructs its own http.Client, owns baseURL+token, and attaches Authorization: Bearer itself; CRABBOX_GITHUB_API_URL is an unrestricted env override that can point the bearer at an arbitrary origin; Go's default redirect policy forwards sensitive headers within same-host and subdomain redirects but the handlers set no explicit policy
no outbound DLP enforcement point exists: payloads go from handler marshaling straight to the network; a configured secret embedded in title/body would ship to the provider

provider health degrades on every UNKNOWN regardless of cause — local pre-dispatch causes (deadline-before-dispatch is handled by ProvableNoEffect, but local executor cancellation and wedged handlers) share the generic RecordAmbiguous path with provider-side transport ambiguity; causality is inferred, not recorded
outer README states the transfer delta as '24 modifications, 4 added paths'; the manifest declares 29 modifications — a hand-maintained count that already drifted
